description_for_human: Natural language to Blender Python scripts via the Claude API. Single-file CLI, pure Python, ARM-compatible.
description_for_model: Command-line tool that compiles natural-language prompts into runnable Blender bpy scripts via the Anthropic Messages API. Supports live execution over the BlenderMCP socket (localhost:9876 by default), scene round-trip, streaming, batch, hot-reload, auto model routing (haiku/sonnet/opus), prompt caching, cost telemetry, replay logs, a JSONL history flywheel with per-run user ratings, an EvoSkillOps reporter that aggregates history into training signals, an EvoSkillOps exporter that emits a fine-tune-ready prompt/completion corpus, theme packs from files or HTTPS URLs, and a Space Metaverse demo catalog (earth/moon/mars/cyberpunk) with KafCade mission briefs.

capabilities.summary: Generate a bpy script from a natural-language prompt.
Execute a generated script in a running Blender via the BlenderMCP socket.
Fetch live Blender scene JSON and inject it into the Claude prompt.
Generate one script per prompt line in a file.
Watch a prompt file and regenerate on every save.
Auto-fix loop: re-prompt Claude on Blender execution errors.
Prepend a style preset to the prompt (built-in: cyberpunk, nature, abstract, scifi, toon).
Load a JSON theme file or HTTPS URL and merge it into the preset table.
Run a built-in Space Metaverse demo (earth/moon/mars/cyberpunk).
Ship a .py file to Blender as-is (no Claude call).
Render a 480x270 preview PNG after execution and open it.
Print per-call USD cost estimate from the PRICING table.
Attach a 1-5 quality rating to the history JSONL record.
Read a history JSONL and print aggregate EvoSkillOps stats.
Emit a fine-tune-ready JSONL of {prompt, completion} filtered by rating.
Retry API call on transient errors with exponential backoff.
Print every available style (built-in + themes) and exit.
Print the Space Metaverse demo catalog with KafCade mission briefs.

security.network: HTTPS to api.anthropic.com + optional MCP TCP to configured host
dangerous_capabilities: executes generated Python code inside Blender via MCP when --send is set
